messages.subject: Can we reserve a specific unit?
messages.body:
Hi,

We'll need equipment again soon and I was hoping we could get the same unit we had last time. It was a good fit for our work. Is there a way to put a hold on it for our next visit?

Best regards,
Oulun Putkiasennus Oy

messages.subject: Re: Can we reserve a specific unit?
messages.body:
Good morning,

I checked and that particular unit is unfortunately committed to another booking right now. What I can do is set aside a replacement unit of the same type for you and hold it at the same rate. It'll be ready whenever you need it.

Just send us the dates when you have them.

Outi Vähäkangas
Regional Manager

messages.subject: Re: Can we reserve a specific unit?
messages.body:
We're ready to book now. Outi confirmed in her reply that a replacement unit would be held for us at the same rate. We've planned our schedule around that commitment so please make sure it stands.

Oulun Putkiasennus Oy
